Hugo Ramirez  
Product Manager | AdvertiseNow Inc.  
hugoramirez@email.com | (555) 123-4567 | Austin, TX  

Professional Summary  
A product manager with 2 years of experience in adtech, focused on bridging data insights with user-centric solutions. Specializes in translating analytics into actionable strategies, managing cross-functional teams, and refining ad targeting tools. Collaborated with engineers, designers, and stakeholders to enhance campaign performance and user engagement. Committed to iterative improvement and measurable outcomes.

- Supported roadmap planning for ad targeting tools, aligning technical capabilities with market demands.
